notes.title: Hotfix D0.01
notes.content:
Hello! The Demo is out and with that, bugs arise! Here is a quick patch to squash the most annoying ones and add some tweaks.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected known spelling errors on some menus
[*] Remove extra sock from House 2
[*] Add collider behind House 3 bed to prevent items from falling behind
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjust House 1 Tutorial Text
[*] Update dice model and texture
[*] Rename some objects from plural to singular
[*] Rename [spoiler]Pink Burrito Roll[/spoiler] to [spoiler]Purple Burrito Roll[/spoiler]
[*] Adjust some item positions in Forest 3
[/list]

notes.title: NOK x Tiny Teams + DEMO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44222817/297fdf3650db777e9eaf114a790c66e5ed64b4e0.png[/img]
[h2]Hello Everyone! It's Steam Event time![/h2]
We are pleased to announce that [b]NOK[/b] will be participating in Yogscast Games Tiny Teams Steam Event! ːsteamhappyː

[i]This is the perfect opportunity to watch some streamers casually struggle to find socks and destroy environments.[/i]

Check out [b]NOK[/b] and other amazing games here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023

[h2]New DEMO[/h2]
We will also take this opportunity to announce that, an early [b]DEMO of the game has become available[/b] for you to play [b]TODAY[/b] so, hop in and give us some feedback & ideas!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2526710/NOK_Demo]STEAM DEMO LINK[/url]

[h2]We want to know your thoughts on NOK![/h2]
What could we do to improve? Is there something you would like to see? Did you find a pesky, annoying bug? We want all the juice! (If you just want to say hi, that's fine too, we don't bite... I think...) ːsteammockingː

Here is the link for the form: [url=https://forms.gle/hBdcZg2unydyZpkU8]https://forms.gle/hBdcZg2unydyZpkU8[/url]
